the_bug_being_fixed.what: `slot` in tf_train.py is the PER-SLOT width and the slot count is 2*depth, so the stream width is 2*depth*slot. Reusing slot=32 across cells pins the stream to 128 at depth 2 (correct, matching the plain model) but to 192 at depth 3.
the_bug_being_fixed.consequence: the depth-3 predicate slot-32 arm carries 2,605,200 parameters against the conventional matched arm's 1,933,696 -- 34.7% MORE -- so the -0.0370 'win' measured there at 17:45 is unfair and was not quoted.
the_bug_being_fixed.the_fix: slot 22 gives stream 132 and 1,794,930 total parameters, 7.2% FEWER than the conventional arm -- almost exactly the 7.0% disadvantage our side carried in the depth-2 comparison (1,523,808 against 1,638,656). It is the correct analogue of that comparison at this cell.

design: predicate variant, slot 22, depth 3 width 128, three seeds, cap ON and cap OFF. 6 cells. Scored against the conventional matched arm without the cap, 4.29770 over three seeds.

L1_the_tax_turns_positive.claim: With parameters honestly matched-or-fewer, the depth-3 symmetric tax is POSITIVE -- the conventional model wins.
L1_the_tax_turns_positive.reason: the -0.0370 apparent win was bought with 34.7% more parameters; removing about 31% of them (2,605,200 -> 1,794,930) should cost more than 0.037 nats. Every honest cross-architecture comparison in this programme so far has favoured the conventional model.

L2_it_is_smaller_than_depth_2s.claim: The depth-3 tax is smaller than depth 2's +0.0759.
L2_it_is_smaller_than_depth_2s.reason: the predicate arm's advantage is hand-installed copying, and the extra block gives it another site to use; also FINDING 21 shows the conventional model's own edge comes increasingly from the softmax-plus-uncapped-range pair, which our arm partly substitutes for by naming the terms outright

L3_the_cap_still_helps_this_architecture.claim: Removing the cap helps the slot-22 arm at depth 3, as it did the slot-32 arm at depth 2 (-0.0120, t = -5.69).
L3_the_cap_still_helps_this_architecture.note: vanilla's cap effect was already null at depth 3 (+0.0043 and -0.0051), so a negative effect here would make it two architectures and two depths against 'load-bearing for the family'

what_this_cannot_settle: The predicate arm buys its induction by hand-installation (24 named scalars carry 98%), so any tax it wins is about LOSS, not about discovered mechanism. That caveat travels with every number here.

Changing slot changes the stream width, so the slot-22 arm is not the same model as the slot-32 arm with fewer parameters -- it is a different point in the family. The comparison is fair on parameters, not on architecture identity across depths.
